Fall & Winter Expo

Description
Get a head start on the holiday season at the Fall & Winter Expo at Willowbrook Mall! Browse a variety of vendors featuring seasonal finds, handmade items, baked goods, candles, Christmas gifts, holiday décor, and much more. Whether you're shopping for fall favorites, unique gifts, or something special for yourself, there's plenty to discover! Stop by and enjoy a weekend of shopping on Friday, November 6th from 9 AM to 5 PM and Saturday, November 7th from 9 AM to 3 PM. For more information, visit https://www.facebook.com/thewillowbrookmall.

Willowbrook Mall

1631 4th Street SW, Mason City, IA 50401
